name: native-e2e-ci
body: Native e2e CI job: GitHub Actions matrix on native runners (macOS arm64, macOS x64, Windows x64, Windows arm64), run against each target's built binary. Steps: in a clean temp dir, `eypres init`, then `eypres start --no-open` in the background; parse the printed URL; poll until HTTP 200 with the two starter slides (timeout about 30s); fetch reveal.js and theme assets and confirm they are served locally from the binary; enforce offline operation by blocking or disabling outbound network for the process or asserting no outbound connections (the mechanism is chosen per OS); terminate the process (SIGTERM on macOS, taskkill/process kill on Windows) and assert a clean exit.
